question: Who hosted the 6th BIMTEC Summit in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Thailand__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 6th BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) Summit was held in Bangkok, Thailand on 4 April 2025. 
 
• Thailand hosted the summit as the current Chair of BIMSTEC (2022–2025). 
 
• The theme was “Prosperous, Resilient, and Open BIMSTEC” focusing on regional cooperation and economic integration

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bhutan**

 
 
• Bhutan is a Himalayan kingdom in South Asia, known for its unique development philosophy of Gross National Happiness (GNH) over GDP.
 
• It is a constitutional monarchy, bordered by India and China, and is an active member of regional groupings like BIMSTEC and SAARC.
 
 
 
• **Indonesia**
 
 
• Indonesia is not a member of BIMSTEC and, therefore, does not participate in its summits.
 
• The country is a member of other regional organizations such as ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) and plays a key role in regional cooperation in Southeast Asia.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka**
 
 
• Sri Lanka hosted the 5th BIMSTEC Summit in 2022, which focused on economic recovery post-COVID-19 and enhancing regional collaboration.
 
• It has been an active member of BIMSTEC and contributes significantly to discussions on maritime security and disaster management.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **BIMSTEC**

 
 
• BIMSTEC was established in 1997 through the Bangkok Declaration to foster regional and economic cooperation among South and Southeast Asian nations.
 
• It covers 14 priority sectors, including trade, technology, energy, transport, fisheries, agriculture, and public health.
 
• The BIMSTEC Secretariat is located in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and serves as the nerve center for its administrative and operational activities.
